name: cgeaa
description: CarGurus Enterprise Applications Automation — a CLI development tool for working with the applications we support, with SDLC guardrails. Teaches Claude to use the `cgeaa` CLI for Salesforce (deploy/validate/test/diff/logs/rollback) and Zuora (`cgeaa zuora ...` billing-object sync), and bundles Oracle's SuiteCloud development skills for NetSuite/SuiteScript/SDF work. Additional application domains are added as new skills over time.
